posts.title: Every Resource, Checked: How AI Agents Audited Our Cloud Bill
posts.description: The usual cost advice covers the big items. We used read-only AI agents and reviewer agents to check every resource in our Azure bill, and cut it by about a quarter.

posts.title: How We Built the AI Factory: Workspaces, Runners and Reports
posts.description: How the AI Factory is designed on top of Multica: one workspace per team, agents whose access does the locking, and a runner per workspace inside a box we control.

posts.title: Your Company's AI Work Shouldn't Live on Someone's Laptop
posts.description: People were building great AI workflows on their own. My boss asked what happens when they leave. The answer was one company platform with a harness around it.
